title: ​Qualcomm, Huawei Sign Patent Licensing Deal Covering 5G to AI
key_facts: Qualcomm said on 5 Oct it signed a patent licensing deal with Huawei.
Cross-licence covering 5G, networking, computing and AI.
Struck on FRAND principles for standard-essential patents.
Qualcomm will buy some Huawei US patents in computing, AI and networking, pending regulatory approval.
Qualcomm expects 6G in commercial service in 2029.
quote_evidence: Qualcomm said Oct. 5 that it had signed a patent licensing agreement with Huawei.
Qualcomm will also purchase some of Huawei's U.S. patents in computing, AI, and networking.
The patent transfer will be completed after receiving regulatory approval.
why_it_matters_hint: Removes patent-lawsuit risk between the two firms.
